system.description: Spend a Fabula Point or erase 4 Favour sections to produce a token of your Patron as a powerful Ritual ingredient, provided the Ritual's effect relates to your Patron's domains. The ingredient is consumed and can only be produced again after you rest in a city or large settlement.
